title: A Love Supreme, Pt. I - Acknowledgement

drums.tags: Samba Batucada. This percussion ensemble piece features a high-pitched repinique leading the call-and-response patterns. The rhythmic core consists of deep, resonant surdo drums playing a syncopated two-beat pattern with a slight swing. Agogô bells provide a melodic, metallic counterpoint with a high-low-high-high rhythmic cell. A tamborim adds sharp, staccato accents and rapid-fire sixteenth-note rolls. Shakers and chocalhos maintain a constant, driving sixteenth-note subdivision. The arrangement follows a traditional street parade structure with sudden breaks and unison rhythmic stops. 132 BPM. 2/4 time signature.

bass.tags: Hard rock with heavy metal influences. Distorted electric guitars play palm-muted chugging riffs and power chords. The bass guitar follows the guitar riffs with a thick, overdriven tone. Drums feature a prominent double-kick pedal pattern and heavy use of crash cymbals. A high-pitched, distorted synthesizer lead plays a repetitive melodic hook. The tempo is 145 BPM in 4/4 time. The arrangement features sudden stops and starts with brief silence between sections. The production uses a dry, close-mic sound on the drums and high-gain saturation on the stringed instruments.
